producer: cuda4AS hand-authored Clang JSON schema conformance fixture

compiler_identity.reason: No compatible local Clang is available in WSL and installation/download is forbidden

capture.reason: The M2A-R1 correction scope forbids a Mac probe

limitations: The JSON records intentionally model Clang direct inner *Attr children and declaration identities.
Clang accepts the device_builtin spelling for CUDA frontend semantics but defines it as an ignored, non-AST attribute; no such child record is modeled.
Builtin identity is accepted only when the exact declaration ID, direct CUDADeviceAttr, pinned const dim3 type, and facade source anchor/hash contract all verify.
This fixture establishes importer schema behavior, not native compiler syntax or Mac execution.
